name: MiniCLEAN Collaboration
notes: No official MiniCLEAN website was found.

SNOLAB's page gives inconsistent counts (participation box: 1 country, 5 institutions, 16 people; tagline: researchers from 7 US institutions) and the paper author lists are larger, so no counts are recorded.

summary.plain: The US-led team that built the MiniCLEAN single-phase liquid argon dark matter detector at SNOLAB in Canada, a prototype for a larger CLEAN detector. It is one of the four founding projects of the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration.
summary.technical: MiniCLEAN Collaboration (author lists of the 2014 and 2019 papers span US universities and national laboratories, Royal Holloway and the SNOLAB Institute). Prototype of the CLEAN programme (Cryogenic Low-Energy Astrophysics with Noble liquids); SNOLAB's experiment page lists 1 country, 5 institutions and 16 people in its participation box but describes 'researchers from 7 US institutions' in its tagline. No roster was recorded.
